Hi Morgan / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — really good discussion on the integration timeline and expected usage profile. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move toward an onboarding cadence: 

- Commercial path: You mentioned procurement prefers paper process for new vendors. Can you confirm whether SapphireTech requires a PO (Net30) or if corporate card is allowed for initial pilot spend? If PO, does procurement create the PO or do you need Redwood to raise an invoice first?

- Marketplace preference: Is there interest in using Coupa/Ariba (you mentioned Coupa) for onboarding, or would you prefer a direct vendor setup? Marketplace enrollment usually speeds vendor verification.

- Docs needed: Confirm we should push a W-9, SOC 2 Type II report, and signed DPA. I attached our onboarding checklist and latest DPA draft for speed.

- Timeline & thresholds: Any contract value bands that force PO vs card? (e.g., card OK under $X). Also target date for pilot purchase?

Next steps I propose: I’ll loop in our Sales Ops and Finance (cc’d) to confirm internal acceptance paths. If PO is required, we’ll send vendor packet and a pro forma invoice to start vendor setup. If card is allowed, we can issue a single charge to accelerate pilot.

From: Morgan Blake <morgan.blake@sapphiretech.com>

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payment routing & procurement follow-up — SapphireTech onboarding

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers: 

- Procurement preference: We prefer PO (Net30) for any vendor onboarding that will be ongoing. For initial pilots under $7,500 we can sometimes allow corporate card, but that requires a business case and pre-approval by procurement.

- Marketplace: We do use Coupa. Ideally vendors go through Coupa so our AP team can auto-match invoices. If Redwood can register in Coupa that’s the fastest route. If not, we’ll create a one-off vendor record, which usually takes longer.

- Required docs: Please provide a completed W-9, your SOC 2 Type II report (latest), and the DPA — procurement must see SOC2 before vendor creation. We also need your company legal name and EIN for the vendor form.

- Timeline: If you’re in Coupa and all docs are uploaded, vendor setup + first PO can be ~5 business days. One-off vendor creation is 8–12 business days.

We are targeting a pilot PO to be issued the week of 5/24 provided vendor is created. Procurement contact: Priya Shah (cc’d on this reply).

Morgan Blake
Director, Strategic Partnerships | SapphireTech
morgan.blake@sapphiretech.com | +1 (212) 555-0199
